Definition: properly, to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere; figuratively, to catch by pursuit
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cling, stick, stay close, cleave, keep close, stick to, stick with, follow closely, join to, overtake, catch; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cling, cleave to; 1a2) to stay with; 1b) (Pual) to be joined together; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to cleave to; 1c2) to pursue closely; 1c3) to overtake; 1d) (Hophal) to be made to cleave
